function.description: This tool belongs to the Gorilla file system. It is a simple file system that allows users to perform basic file operations such as navigating directories, creating files and directories, reading and writing to files, etc. Tool description: Change the current working directory to the specified folder. folder.description: The folder of the directory to change to. You can only change one folder level at a time.

If the destination is a directory, the source file or directory will be copied into the destination directory.  Both source and destination must be local to the current directory. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

source.description: The name of the file or directory to copy.

destination.description: The destination name to copy the file or directory to. If the destination is a directory, the source will be copied into this directory. No file paths allowed.

function.description: This tool belongs to the Gorilla file system.
